chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Finding Nazarro after twelve and a half years in a rest home
summary: When Green returns from the home, he tracks Nazarro to his West 57th Street apartment, where Nazarro talks about Bubbles and Chuckles.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: What about that time when he came to the door after you hadn't seen him for a while?

Oh, yeah. Yeah, well, sometime after that, a few years later I went into a rest home. I went into a home, and I had been away for about 12 and a half years. Then when I came back, I was looking up Mr. Nazarro, and -- find out where he was at. So he was up on 57th Street there at -- what's that place called? I think the Vena Park or

something, Park Venice, and -- apartments. So I finally found out what apartment he was in, and I went up to his door. I rang the bell, and he opened the door, and he was standing up in his underwear, you know.

And he says, 'Well, why didn't you call? You know, -- (Laughter) -- I said, 'I just got -- I been out of the hospital, you know, and I'm living in my aunt Brooklyn, you know, and I say I had to come over -- he told me to come and see you. I was trying to find you. I couldn't find you.'

And he says, 'How did you find me?' I said, 'Well, I went to the office where you were, and they told me that -- they gave me your address, 350 West 57th Street, apartment, so I came up.' He says, 'Well, you know, that Bubbles, he's -- you know, he's -- he hangs around some spot downtown there, you know. He's (inaudible) -- and Chuckles is getting just like him, you know. You can't tell them nothing, you know.' (Laughter)

And I had been away 12 1/2 years, and that's how he was talking. Like I ain't been nowhere, you see. So anyhow I didn't see him any more after that. He passed away. He -- unfortunately, but so I've been continuing with my career, because I think that's what he would want me to do, you see, and I finally got to tap dancing with some fellows, got a show
